**Finding: deviation (high severity) — Section 2.2 (p0013)**

Section 2.2 makes Vendor our "sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services throughout the term" — full-term exclusive dealing with no category/time limit and no performance-based exit, which is walk-away territory and fails the fallback. It also directly conflicts with Section 2.1 (no purchase commitment) and Section 12.3 (Vendor acknowledges we have made no exclusivity commitment).

Redline (validated, preferred position): recast Vendor as a **non-exclusive** provider and expressly preserve our right to source the same or similar services from third parties, which also cures the internal inconsistency.
